title: Walk reachability probability
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $n$ be a natural number, and suppose the encoded adjacency relation is symmetric on vertices below $n$. Let $t\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and suppose $2|x|+2\le B$ and $2n+2+2n^2\le |x|$. For every natural number $k$, register state $\sigma$, and vertex $v\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ such that $\sigma.L-\sigma.st=k$, every field of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, $\sigma.n=n$, $\sigma.cur=v$, $\sigma.t=t$, and $\sigma.st\le\sigma.L$, the program started at state $w0$ with register state $\sigma$ has probabilistic semantics with acceptance probability equal to the probability that a uniformly chosen length-$k$ walk on the padded regular multigraph reaches $t$ from $v$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a Boolean word and $n$ is natural
The encoded adjacency relation is symmetric on vertices below $n$
Every field of $\sigma$ is at most $B$
replaced:
Let $x$ be a Boolean word and $n$ a natural number such that the encoded adjacency
relation is symmetric on vertices below $n$. For any target vertex
$t\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, bound $B$, and natural numbers $k$ and register record $\sigma$,
suppose $2|x|+2\le B$, $2n+2+2n^2\le |x|$, $\sigma.L-\sigma.st=k$, every register of
$\sigma$ is at most $B$, $\sigma.n=n$, $\sigma.cur$ is the natural-number value of some
vertex $v\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, $\sigma.t=t$, and $\sigma.st\le\sigma.L$. Then the program
started at state $w0$ with record $\sigma$ has a terminating probabilistic semantics,
with all register values bounded by $B$, whose probability of reaching the target in a
uniformly random walk of length $k$ on the padded graph is the graph's $k$-step hit
probability from $v$ to $t$.
